mainEntity.name: How do I book a minicab from Ruislip HA4 to Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book online through our secure platform, call our team directly, or complete a reservation in minutes. All Ruislip HA4 bookings receive instant confirmation with driver details and a guaranteed fixed price.

mainEntity.name: How far is Ruislip HA4 from Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ruislip HA4 is approximately 7 miles (11 km) from Heathrow Airport. The route typically follows the A4180 south connecting to the A4020 (Uxbridge Road) eastbound toward Heathrow, or alternatively via the A4180 onto Bath Road into the terminal access roads. Journey times typically range from 20 to 30 minutes depending on traffic conditions.
